create_graph: create a gtn Graph object to build a finite state transducer for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn Graph with optional start and final state flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw a gtn Graph and export it as a PDF file with symbol labels
union_graphs: compute the union of multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph
